data.body:
Gerrit change 2212 patch set 1 got LLM-Review -1 (1 blocking + 7 advisory). Patch set 2 dispositions:

FIXED (blocking): added tests/scripts/test_observability_mcp_markers.py driving the REAL observability.sh over a synthetic journal — asserts AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP/MCP_MEM_ABORT each count into their own rebar/host metric, no cross-contamination, record-anchor (prose not counted), delta/cold-start behavior.

FIXED (advisory, real safety bug — correctness): mcp_retire_sweep would docker-stop EVERY running managed container when the live port is unknown (upstream include missing/unreadable) because the keep-guard short-circuited to false — it could kill the live backend, the exact 7b4a guarantee this target preserves. Now fails SAFE: never stops a running container when live is unknown (still reaps exited ones). Added RED-first test test_retire_never_stops_running_containers_when_live_port_unknown.

FIXED (advisory, tests): strengthened test_unreadable_memory_fails_open with a liveness anchor (proves the deploy reached+passed the mem gate and completed the cutover, not a vacuous absence check); added an anti-vacuity floor to the compose-parity test (env>=5 keys incl. the core REBAR_MCP_* + >=2 :ro mounts).

FIXED (advisory, robustness): docker tag failure is now fatal (err mcp-tag-failed + backoff) instead of '|| true'-swallowed; the memory fail-open branch now emits a log breadcrumb noting MemAvailable was unreadable.

DEFERRED (advisory) with rationale:
- gerrit blast-radius on the mcp block emits err (non-fatal), MATCHING the existing review-bot block convention (autodeploy.sh:599). Making only mcp fatal would be inconsistent; changing both is a cross-cutting decision beyond this ticket. The AC only requires the id be unchanged (asserted).
- --restart always is MANDATED by this ticket's compose-parity AC (docker run must reproduce the compose mcp service exactly); the retire sweep docker-rm's exited containers each tick, bounding the reboot-resurrection window. Changing the restart policy would violate the compose-parity oracle and the spec.
